raw: [name="Greyy"]And you... You were created with Arts. You're a byproduct born in the Pioneers' minds.
speaker: Greyy
content: And you... You were created with Arts. You're a byproduct born in the Pioneers' minds.

raw: [name="Greyy"]Humanity triumphed over the darkness of night... How could we lose to our own creations?
speaker: Greyy
content: Humanity triumphed over the darkness of night... How could we lose to our own creations?

raw: A ray of light emits from his hand and bolts toward the dark shadow floating above their heads.
content: A ray of light emits from his hand and bolts toward the dark shadow floating above their heads.

raw: As expected, a not insignificant amount of silver liquid exits out of the Pioneers' quarters and entangles itself with the dark night as it tears madly toward the light he released.
content: As expected, a not insignificant amount of silver liquid exits out of the Pioneers' quarters and entangles itself with the dark night as it tears madly toward the light he released.

raw: That moment, the light is shredded into pieces, leaving only a few strands progressing deeper into the darkness.
content: That moment, the light is shredded into pieces, leaving only a few strands progressing deeper into the darkness.

raw: But more and more lights then rise one after another.
content: But more and more lights then rise one after another.

speaker: Dorothy
content: Greyy's a brave man.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]He's just like Sonny... and the pioneers. He has the courage to face his challenges head on.
speaker: Dorothy
content: He's just like Sonny... and the pioneers. He has the courage to face his challenges head on.

[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Silence
content: Its attacks have gotten stronger again...

raw: [name="Silence"]All my light can do is distract it; it still sees us as its target.
speaker: Silence
content: All my light can do is distract it; it still sees us as its target.

speaker: Dorothy
content: *cough*... *cough* *cough*...

speaker: Silence
content: Your nose is bleeding...

raw: [name="Silence"]Even if you have no infected organs, your body's blood vessels won't be able to withstand releasing this much energy... It won't take long for you to hemorrhage to death.
speaker: Silence
content: Even if you have no infected organs, your body's blood vessels won't be able to withstand releasing this much energy... It won't take long for you to hemorrhage to death.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]I... I must protect them, and I'm willing to...
speaker: Dorothy
content: I... I must protect them, and I'm willing to...

speaker: Silence
content: You're willing to give your life.

raw: [name="Silence"]That's not an excuse you're using to win over the Pioneers.
speaker: Silence
content: That's not an excuse you're using to win over the Pioneers.

speaker: Silence
content: You're... really going to do it.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]Dr. Silence, wouldn't you make the same choice to protect your family?
speaker: Dorothy
content: Dr. Silence, wouldn't you make the same choice to protect your family?

speaker: Dorothy
content: I made the wrong decision once.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]And I won't... make the same mistake again.
speaker: Dorothy
content: And I won't... make the same mistake again.

speaker: Silence
content: You mean, your mother...?

raw: [name="Dorothy"]All these years, I've wondered over and over...
speaker: Dorothy
content: All these years, I've wondered over and over...

raw: [name="Dorothy"]How did they feel before they were swallowed whole by the sandstorm?
speaker: Dorothy
content: How did they feel before they were swallowed whole by the sandstorm?

raw: [name="Dorothy"]Did they wait, despairing in a cramped space until the moment of death arrived, like these Pioneers?
speaker: Dorothy
content: Did they wait, despairing in a cramped space until the moment of death arrived, like these Pioneers?

raw: What if I didn't accept that invitation? Would I have stayed with my mother until the very end?
content: What if I didn't accept that invitation? Would I have stayed with my mother until the very end?

raw: If she had the qualifications to enter the city with me, would that have spared her from the storm?
content: If she had the qualifications to enter the city with me, would that have spared her from the storm?

raw: My research has solved many difficult problems that were unsolvable, but I still haven't found an answer to this one—
content: My research has solved many difficult problems that were unsolvable, but I still haven't found an answer to this one—

raw: Why was I the only one spared?
content: Why was I the only one spared?

speaker: Dorothy
content: Dr. Silence...

raw: [name="Dorothy"]If... If that is really the assemblage of the test subjects' consciousnesses...
speaker: Dorothy
content: If... If that is really the assemblage of the test subjects' consciousnesses...

raw: [name="Dorothy"]I love it, just as I loved my family.
speaker: Dorothy
content: I love it, just as I loved my family.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]But why... why can't I hear it speak to me?
speaker: Dorothy
content: But why... why can't I hear it speak to me?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=8, ystrength=6, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
A deep fissure appears in the sand wall.
content: A deep fissure appears in the sand wall.

raw: Dorothy stumbles forward, but a pair of hands catches her.
content: Dorothy stumbles forward, but a pair of hands catches her.

raw: [name="Silence"]Dorothy... No matter how much work you put in, you can't change your mother's fate.
speaker: Silence
content: Dorothy... No matter how much work you put in, you can't change your mother's fate.

raw: [name="Silence"]That storm is in the past... it ended long ago.
speaker: Silence
content: That storm is in the past... it ended long ago.

speaker: Dorothy
content: Is... that so?

raw: A drone fills the opening in the sand wall with its own body.
content: A drone fills the opening in the sand wall with its own body.

raw: Seemingly injected with life once again, the grains of sand quickly rearrange in an orderly way.
content: Seemingly injected with life once again, the grains of sand quickly rearrange in an orderly way.

raw: [name="Silence"]Dorothy, you want to hear your family's voices, right?
speaker: Silence
content: Dorothy, you want to hear your family's voices, right?

speaker: Silence
content: You should ask those test subjects.

raw: [name="Silence"]Once the storm is over, they will tell you their answer.
speaker: Silence
content: Once the storm is over, they will tell you their answer.

speaker: Greyy
content: Agh...

raw: His hand is getting warmer and warmer. He knows that the machinery has been pushed past its limits for so long it is doomed to break.
content: His hand is getting warmer and warmer. He knows that the machinery has been pushed past its limits for so long it is doomed to break.
But he cannot give up.

raw: If he falls here, the island behind him will forever be swallowed whole by the darkness.
content: If he falls here, the island behind him will forever be swallowed whole by the darkness.

raw: He has to hold on, just like that one night all those years ago. He ran so far away, even though his hands had gone numb from the cold and his legs hurt from the long journey—
content: He has to hold on, just like that one night all those years ago. He ran so far away, even though his hands had gone numb from the cold and his legs hurt from the long journey—

raw: He needs to make it to that day when he passes the torch he holds to another pair of hands.
content: He needs to make it to that day when he passes the torch he holds to another pair of hands.

raw: Suddenly, a warm power shrouds his hand and helps him stabilize his energy output.
content: Suddenly, a warm power shrouds his hand and helps him stabilize his energy output.
It is someone else's Arts.

speaker: Greyy
content: O-Operator Ptilopsis...?

speaker: Ptilopsis
content: You require assistance, Operator Greyy.

speaker: Greyy
content: Hmm...

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]You needn't alert me to the danger here.
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: You needn't alert me to the danger here.

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]I had already calculated the probability of our mission's success before I submitted my leave request to Dr. Silence.
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: I had already calculated the probability of our mission's success before I submitted my leave request to Dr. Silence.

speaker: Greyy
content: What's the number...?

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]With my support as a newly added variable, the probability of our success is...
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: With my support as a newly added variable, the probability of our success is...

raw: [name="Greyy"]No, you don't have to tell me.
speaker: Greyy
content: No, you don't have to tell me.

raw: [name="Greyy"]I'm just used to planning everything out before the actual execution. I know it was hasty of me to run out here, but I couldn't control myself.
speaker: Greyy
content: I'm just used to planning everything out before the actual execution. I know it was hasty of me to run out here, but I couldn't control myself.

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]Calculating the results will not reveal anything in advance.
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: Calculating the results will not reveal anything in advance.

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]Operator Greyy, what determines the result in the end will always be...
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: Operator Greyy, what determines the result in the end will always be...

speaker: Ptilopsis
content: The 'impulse' that drives you forward.

raw: [name="Ptilopsis"]I cannot confirm whether the fluctuations of my brainwaves right now were caused by this 'impulse,' but it was none other than your actions that drove me here.
speaker: Ptilopsis
content: I cannot confirm whether the fluctuations of my brainwaves right now were caused by this 'impulse,' but it was none other than your actions that drove me here.

speaker: Greyy
content: Operator Ptilopsis...

speaker: Greyy
content: Thanks.

raw: Even more light begins to emanate above him.
content: Even more light begins to emanate above him.

raw: This is beyond the theoretical maximum output numbers that he and Mechanist, the designers of the weapon, had yet to measure.
content: This is beyond the theoretical maximum output numbers that he and Mechanist, the designers of the weapon, had yet to measure.
But these are his Arts.

raw: There has never been a theory capable of fully explaining Originium Arts... And furthermore, this luminance comes not only from his Arts Unit... It comes from his heart.
content: There has never been a theory capable of fully explaining Originium Arts... And furthermore, this luminance comes not only from his Arts Unit... It comes from his heart.

raw: This luminance in the end pierces through the out-of-control test subject, through the darkness, the clouds, and all the unknowns above.
content: This luminance in the end pierces through the out-of-control test subject, through the darkness, the clouds, and all the unknowns above.

raw: This thought, hidden within the sparks of electricity, pulses once only.
content: This thought, hidden within the sparks of electricity, pulses once only.

raw: Nonetheless, Greyy grasps hold of it—He can feel the possibility within.
content: Nonetheless, Greyy grasps hold of it—He can feel the possibility within.

speaker: Ptilopsis
content: A weak signal has been detected...

speaker: Ptilopsis
content: Connecting.

speaker: Greyy
content: Phew...

raw: Following an intense quake, the enormous test subject positions itself in front of the assembled onlookers.
content: Following an intense quake, the enormous test subject positions itself in front of the assembled onlookers.

raw: There was no foreshadowing, and it left no trails of its movement. It simply appeared in that very position.
content: There was no foreshadowing, and it left no trails of its movement. It simply appeared in that very position.

speaker: Greyy
content: Agh...

speaker: Silence
content: Stand back, Greyy!

speaker: Silence
content: That's an order—
Silence grabs Greyy's other hand.

content: A drone takes to the sky and, gathering the golden rays that began to disperse as Greyy's strength starts to give, charges straight toward the silver colossus that shrouds the sky.

content: The explosion is as loud as a thunderclap. The drone, having risen to the highest point in the sky, disintegrates into countless specks of light that flutter down.

speaker: Silence
content: I picked this up from Elena.

raw: [name="Silence"]Though a trick like this will only work once.
speaker: Silence
content: Though a trick like this will only work once.

speaker: Silence
content: This light... will extinguish eventually.

speaker: Ptilopsis
content: Message sent.

raw: [name="Greyy"]Our most crucial objective has been completed, right?
speaker: Greyy
content: Our most crucial objective has been completed, right?

speaker: Silence
content: Yes...

speaker: Silence
content: We did it.

raw: She reaches her other hand out to hold Ptilopsis.
content: She reaches her other hand out to hold Ptilopsis.

raw: The light above them slowly dissipates, revealing the enormous scale of the silver construct.
content: The light above them slowly dissipates, revealing the enormous scale of the silver construct.
Yet it does not advance.

raw: A layer of fine dust still stubbornly stands between them.
content: A layer of fine dust still stubbornly stands between them.

speaker: Silence
content: Dorothy...?

raw: [name="Silence"]You're holding... a treatment band and the reagent.
speaker: Silence
content: You're holding... a treatment band and the reagent.

speaker: Silence
content: You're thinking of plugging yourself in...

speaker: Dorothy
content: I want to hear their voices.

speaker: Silence
content: No!

raw: [name="Silence"]I told you. I don't know how to wake them up, and I won't know how to wake you up!
speaker: Silence
content: I told you. I don't know how to wake them up, and I won't know how to wake you up!

raw: [name="Silence"]You might find yourself swallowed by their consciousness, and your nervous system might see irreversible damage if we destroy this construct, and perhaps...
speaker: Silence
content: You might find yourself swallowed by their consciousness, and your nervous system might see irreversible damage if we destroy this construct, and perhaps...

raw: [name="Dorothy"]I'm a researcher. I'm willing to accept all the uncertainties.
speaker: Dorothy
content: I'm a researcher. I'm willing to accept all the uncertainties.

speaker: Silence
content: But I'm your doctor!

raw: [name="Silence"]I can't just watch you risk your own life—
speaker: Silence
content: I can't just watch you risk your own life—

speaker: Dorothy
content: It'll be fine, Olivia.

raw: [name="Dorothy"]This way, I will get to be with my family.
speaker: Dorothy
content: This way, I will get to be with my family.

content: The test subjects behind her are unable to speak.

content: The silver construct before her remains silent as ever.

content: Dorothy closes her eyes and feels the silver reagent flow into her body.

raw: The slightly cold sensation feels as if the fingertips of her family members are caressing her up and down.
content: The slightly cold sensation feels as if the fingertips of her family members are caressing her up and down.

speaker: Dorothy
content: Olivia...

speaker: Dorothy
content: I need the answer.
